description: Prepare a bubble (post) for PowPow and save it as a draft — **it is not public yet**. Publishing requires a second call to publish_post with the returned draft_id. content is the body text (up to 5000 characters); images are pictures the user uploaded in the conversation (at most 3) — if the user attached an image, pass that image as a file using the client-provided file reference, never invent a URL. A post needs either text or at least one image, so pass at least one of the two. place is an optional place name that resolves to a map location, so the bubble appears at that place once published. Drafts are valid for 1 hour.

content.description: Body text, up to 5000 characters. Write it for a human reader; no HTML tags. Optional: a post needs either content or at least one image

images.description: Images the user uploaded in the conversation, at most 3. Pass them when the user attached images, using the client-provided file reference; never invent a download_url or image link

download_url.description: Temporary download URL provided by ChatGPT (it expires; the server transfers the file immediately).

file_id.description: File id, used for de-duplication and for referencing the file across turns.

place.description: Place name, e.g. "Forbidden City", "Guomao". Leave empty to publish without a location (feed only, not on the map)

name: prepare_post
title: Prepare a Post
